title: The New Covenant Inaugurated: Matthew
subtitle: Matthew 1-28
theme: Jesus as the new Moses, new David, and new Israel. The Kingdom arrives in a person.
memoryText: You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.
reviewQuestions: How does Matthew’s genealogy establish Jesus as the fulfillment of the OT covenants?
What does the Sermon on the Mount reveal about the relationship between law and gospel?
What does it mean that Jesus came not to abolish the law but to fulfill it?
How does Matthew present the death and resurrection of Jesus as the climax of Israel’s story?
psalmsNote: Psalm 1 beside the Sermon on the Mount. Psalms 146 and 147 beside the healings. Psalms 2 and 110 beside the Transfiguration. Psalm 118 in Holy Week.
